source_evidence.finding: Panel reset/init/display-on calls ignore results; EmoteDisplay is constructed before start_lvgl; backlight brightness is restored afterward.
Flush skips blit without a default display or dummy-draw mode, ignores the blit result, and always notifies completion. Constructor initializes Emote.
GFX uses an asynchronous task and requests refresh_all at task startup; source ordering alone does not prove a skipped first frame.

conclusions: The new startup section accurately separates the earlier intermittent black screen and initial residual pixels from confirmed runtime DMA allocation failures.
Initialization ordering is a plausible diagnostic lead, not a demonstrated first-frame loss or hardware defect.
Persistent partial power while USB remains connected is explicitly a hypothesis requiring verification against the actual power circuit.

Architecture and pipeline additions consistently request reset/init result checks, adapter readiness, first full transfer completion and comparison of cold power-on, power-switch operation and software restart.
The sealed E3f-9d.2 candidate remains prepared for later App-only installation; startup changes are not included in that candidate.
